anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_slothful_: Ultimate. The skill of the Black Axe of Sloth, a Weapon of Mortal Sin. Modes: Technique (Dead Weight, the right click of the axe in your main hand) and Manifest / Store (the axe is built out of the skill: hold it to store it back, otherwise a bound one is forged).
